description: This is a shell script used for configuring wireless interfaces, restarting hostapd, managing network bridges, editing configuration files, and starting services on a router or network device. It contains functions to restart hostapd on 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz bands, modifies configuration files, manages network interfaces, and runs network services like dnsmasq and lighttpd.

methods.name: Restart_Hostapd
methods.description: Function to restart the hostapd service for the 2.4 GHz interface, bringing down/waiting/killing existing instances, then starting hostapd.

methods.name: Restart_Hostapd_5G
methods.description: Function to restart the hostapd service for the 5 GHz interface, including module reloading.

methods.name: Hostapd_Restart
methods.description: Function to restart hostapd for the interface, similar to Restart_Hostapd.
